scripts.build: npm --prefix functions run build && react-router build
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run update-csp-hashes && firebase deploy --config firebase.generated.json
scripts.deploy:rules: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase deploy --only functions,firestore,storage
scripts.deploy:ttl: for pair in rateLimits:expiresAt records:expiresAt users:deleteAt pastEvents:deleteAt upcomingEvents:deleteAt badges:deleteAt claimCodes:expiresAt badgeActivationCodes:expiresAt scans:expiresAt scanQuota:expiresAt; do gcloud firestore fields ttls update ${pair#*:} --collection-group=${pair%:*} --enable-ttl --async --quiet || exit 1; done
